obligationText: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity, and the forensic analysis of events. Audit logs capture all individual user access to cardholder data; all actions taken by any individual with administrative access, including any interactive use of application or system accounts; all access to audit logs; all invalid logical access attempts; all changes to identification and authentication credentials; the initialization, stopping or pausing of the existing audit logs; and the creation and deletion of system-level objects.
